bounded_interpretation.observation: Complete natural replays expose typed health/lives boundaries and exact first producer-call/target/store plus resident scene-flow/respawn coverage across multiple scenes.
bounded_interpretation.inference: Each retained path reaches the resident transition initiator from one statically enumerated native producer boundary. Paths with the exact death-law PCs share C16's final-life or ordinary-respawn law; the E10 hazard kind and actor owner remain unknown.
bounded_interpretation.causal_confirmation: The one-frame health/lives divergence executes one newly reached enumerated direct call, 0x8004A700 and its health store. Every pass is byte/register/cycle/frame equal to its uninstrumented replay; the joined control is execution identity, not a filename.
bounded_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Do not assign a hazard kind, scripted/special classification, E10 actor owner, overlay-private predicate, persistence law, or C16 completion from these natural leads.

bounded_open_frontier.trigger_ownership: E10 must still identify the hazard kind and actor/script owner; this pass closes only the exact native producer-call boundary.
bounded_open_frontier.frontend_card: Continue alternatives, corrupt/no-card behavior and native card effects remain open.
bounded_open_frontier.stage_breadth: The retained scenes widen C16 but do not cover every campaign, bonus, boss, scripted or exceptional death path.
bounded_open_frontier.next_experiment: Use the existing frontend movie/card fixtures to separate Continue refusal/alternatives and serialized effects.
